data.name: Deliver Touch Spells
data.description: A valet can deliver touch spells for his master. If the master and the valet are in contact at the time the master casts a touch spell, he can designate the valet as the "toucher." The valet can then deliver the touch spell just as the master would. When delivering a harmless touch spell to a willing creature, a valet can move before and after delivering the spell, as long as its total movement does not exceed its speed.
